task.description: The task to review, for example "(Task) 743 Shard Invocations". It must be in review.

make-ready.say: {{task}} is reviewing: another review runs now. Wait until it ends. When that review stopped, open this review with the --not-ready command, and say why.

next.interactive: Set {{task}} to reviewing, verify each checkbox against reality, and give the findings to the person.
next.headless: Set {{task}} to reviewing, set the phase verifying, and verify each checkbox against reality. Keep the findings for the Task Log and the result.

next.interactive: Fix each failed item that is straightforward, and log it under Review fixes. Flag each other item to the person, until the person confirms.
next.headless: Set the phase resolving. Fix each failed item that is straightforward, and log it under Review fixes. Use a deferred request for a decision that you cannot make.

next.interactive: Set {{task}} to reviewed with the completed date, and write the last Task Log entry. Do not set done: a person does that. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Set {{task}} to reviewed with the completed date, and write the last Task Log entry. Do not set done: a person does that. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Then return with flint orbh session return --finish.
